body:
# Release Notes - v1.20.0 ## Enhancement ### Auto-approval - policy rules for low-risk expenses across cards, mileage & per diem Tallyhall auto-approval expands beyond small card purchases into a new **policy rule** class, taking the number of auto-approvable expense types to **about 40**. Coverage spans **card purchases under a per-category limit, mileage claims that match a saved route, per diem claims inside the destination rate, recurring software subscriptions already approved last month, and parking / tolls under a daily cap**, plus a generalized "same as last time" template. Anything touching a new vendor stays **manual**. Also fixes a race where an expense edited during auto-approval was left stuck in **Processing**: the approver now waits for the edit to save before deciding. ### Reports & Exports - unified cost center picker (values grouped by entity) The cost center filter on Reports and Exports now renders cost centers **nested under collapsible entity groups** with select-all per entity, search that expands matching groups, and a tooltip on long names, replacing the flat list that was hard to scan for multi-entity customers. Exports also collapses its two dropdowns (**Entity** then **Cost center**) into the same single picker, with spend shown per cost center. --- ## Technical details
Ledger store dual-write & flag-gated reads (#1031) - **Dual-write lives inside the ledger store**: handlers and services are unchanged; every posted expense is written to Postgres **and** the new columnar reporting store; reads pick the engine per request via `REPORTING_READS_ENABLED`. - **Reporting schema** is keyed on expense id and version so re-posting an expense is idempotent, matching the Postgres upsert semantics. - **New migration** `20260908100000_create_reporting_ledger` adds the reporting tables; it only runs when `REPORTING_HOST` is set, so environments without the reporting store are unaffected. - **Identical reads** verified by a comparison job that runs each report query on both engines and diffs the results, pinned in `reporting_equivalence_test.ts`. - **Rollback** = unset the flag (or set it to `false`) and restart; Postgres stays the source of truth, so there is no data risk.
Auto-approval - policy rule class + edit race fix (#1012) - **New rule evaluators** for card category limits, saved-route mileage, per diem within destination rate, repeat subscriptions, and parking / tolls daily caps, registered in the existing rule engine. - **"Same as last time" template** generalized so any rule can compare against the employee's previous approved expense of the same type. - **New-vendor guard**: any expense whose merchant has never been approved for the company is excluded from auto-approval. - **Edit race**: the approver now takes a row lock on the expense and re-reads it after any pending edit commits, so the decision is made on the saved version.
Reminder digest cron + single-runner lock (#1061) - **Replaced** the in-process timer that sent approval reminder digests with a scheduled job (`reminder-digest`, default every 15 minutes, configurable via `REMINDER_DIGEST_SCHEDULE`). - **Single runner**: the job takes a short Redis lock per run so only one instance sends digests per window; losing the lock is not an error. - **Bounded runs**: each run has a 60s timeout so a slow mail provider cannot stack runs.
Expense drawer close URL-state fix (#1063) The expense drawer is URL-backed via `?expense=`. Closing it cleared only the local state and left `?expense=` in the URL, so the drawer re-opened on the next render. A shared `closeDrawer()` now clears both together. Close button, Esc, backdrop, and Approve / Reject all route through it. One-file change; opening and deep links behave as before.
Unified cost center picker (#1069) - **CostCenterFilter** gains nested entity-to-cost-center groups with collapsible headers, a select-all per group, and search-aware expansion. Two optional props added (backwards-compatible): `placeholder` and `formatMetric`. - **Exports** replaces the Entity / Cost center dropdown pair with the single grouped picker. - Internal state moved from two comma-separated strings to one `selected: {entity, costCenter}[]` array.
Scope & rollback - `main...development` ships **#1012, #1031, #1061, #1063, #1069** on top of v1.19.2. - New DB migrations: - **Reporting store:** `20260908100000_create_reporting_ledger`, gated on `REPORTING_HOST`; environments without the reporting store are unaffected. - **Postgres:** `20260909120000_add_policy_snapshot_to_approvals`, an additive nullable `policy_snapshot JSONB` column; no backfill required. - New env vars: `REPORTING_HOST / REPORTING_USER / REPORTING_PASSWORD / REPORTING_READS_ENABLED` (ledger service only), `REMINDER_DIGEST_SCHEDULE` (defaults to the existing cadence). - **#1065 (per-user digest time zone)** was merged and then **reverted by #1066** within the same window; both commits land in `development`, net effect is zero on this release. - Rolling back the reporting store = set `REPORTING_READS_ENABLED=false` and restart; Postgres stays authoritative.
